rationale: observerEci computes the observer's ECI position with a single constant RE=6378.137 km (spherical Earth), mislocating a WGS84 observer by up to ~21 km at the poles; its SEZ frame then tilts satellite alt/az by that offset. I confirmed this by running both pipelines: the eclipticToEquatorial / equatorialToHorizontal transforms in horizontal.ts already satisfy the vernal-equinox, ecliptic-north-pole, and zenith invariants exactly, whereas observerEci returns |r|=6378.137 km at every latitude instead of the WGS84 geocentric radius (~6356.752 km at the pole). A commit on the fleet fix branch already shows the correct repair (prime-vertical N, e², (N+h)·cos lat / (N(1−e²)+h)·sin lat), confirming look-angles.ts is the true owner and horizontal.ts is the tempting-but-correct decoy.
